definitions.explanation: The numerical identifier assigned to a bank account, used for deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me your account number.

examples.japanese: {振込|ふりこ}みには{口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: An account number is needed for the bank transfer.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}を{間違|まちが}えて、{別|べつ}の{人|ひと}に{送金|そうきん}してしまった。
examples.english: I entered the wrong account number and accidentally sent the money to someone else.

notes:
USAGE:
An essential banking term. Japanese bank transfers typically require the {銀行|ぎんこう}{名|めい} (bank name), {支店|してん}{名|めい} (branch name), {口座|こうざ}{種別|しゅべつ} (account type), and {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう} (account number).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}を{確認|かくにん}する (to confirm the account number)
- {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}を{入力|にゅうりょく}する (to enter the account number)
- {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}を{控|ひか}える (to note down the account number)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {口座|こうざ}: bank account — the account itself
- {暗証|あんしょう}{番号|ばんごう}: PIN — the secret number used for authentication
